test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: On the eve of International Women's Day 2022, the Ministry of Women and Child Development, in collaboration with the Ministry of Education and UNICEF, launched a landmark campaign to reintegrate out-of-school adolescent girls in India. What is the name of this campaign?
solution:
The correct answer is __Kanya Shiksha Pravesh Utsav.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ministry of Women and Child Development, in partnership with Ministry of Education and UNICEF, launched a campaign 'Kanya Shiksha Pravesh Utsav', on 7 March 2022.
 
• It has been launched to bring back out-of-school adolescent girls in India to the formal education and/or skilling system.
 
• Over 400 districts will be funded under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao scheme for awareness generation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
